rows.evidence:
On the current pages the preload is right: my audit (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/6f74c4e7-484a-542c-982f-ae21506915ed/scratchpad/L07-data/r4/imports.py) parsed every S7 and AP1 lab with ast and compared with lab_preload: every page's preload equals its top-level import statements, every declared data-package is imported (numpy everywhere; scipy on AP1 L02, L03, L07), no matched line fails to parse, and each page's preload compiles. But IMPORT_LINE is a text regex over every line, not a parse of import statements, so on legal lab code it (a) preloads modules a lab does not import: a docstring line 'import scipy.optimize as so' inside a lab's triple-quoted string is collected ('import scipy.optimize as so
import numpy as np'); (b) executes non-import code: the whole line is kept, so 'import numpy as np; <anything>' runs that code in the shared runtime during preload (observed: 12.8 s preload in the mutant of the previous row); (c) breaks on valid code: a docstring line starting 'from the training half ...' made the preload raise SyntaxError, which page.evaluate re-raised uncaught, so page_smoke --unit AP1 --pages L05 aborted with a traceback instead of reporting a page problem (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/6f74c4e7-484a-542c-982f-ae21506915ed/scratchpad/L07-data/r4/mut2, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/6f74c4e7-484a-542c-982f-ae21506915ed/scratchpad/L07-data/r4/mut2_smoke.out, rc=1); a ruff-formatted parenthesized multi-line 'from scipy.optimize import (
    linprog,
    minimize,
)' is captured as the unclosed 'from scipy.optimize import (' (SyntaxError: '(' was never closed); and 'from __future__ import annotations' in any lab but the first yields 'from __future__ imports must occur at the beginning of the file'. tests/test_page_smoke.py covers only the indented-import and print-string cases, none of these. None of this hides a slow lab or changes a current result (fails closed), so it is a latent defect, but the requirement 'preload only what labs actually import' does not hold for the code as written.
rows.fix: In tools/page_smoke.py replace the IMPORT_LINE regex with an AST walk: for each lab, tree = ast.parse(lab.code) (completion labs: parse the twin, lab.twin.read_text(), since the page code has ___ blanks); collect ast.unparse(node) for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) and not (isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == '__future__'); dedupe in order. Wrap the preload page.evaluate in try/except playwright Error and append f'package preload failed: {{error}}' to problems instead of raising. Add tests to tests/test_page_smoke.py: an import inside a docstring is not collected; 'import numpy as np; x = 1' yields only 'import numpy as np'; a parenthesized multi-line from-import is collected whole and compiles; a __future__ import is dropped; a docstring line starting with 'from ' is ignored.
